---
title: "Sensitivity Analysis: Stable and Month-to-Month Identity Development Experiences"
author: "XXXX"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

In the primary model, the monthly identity development experience counts are observed predictors, so their effects could reflect stable differences between young people as well as month-to-month change. This file separates the two (Supplementary Material S4; Tables S13a and S13b).

The counts at W1 to W4 are split into:

* a random intercept: each young person's typical level of identity development experiences, which covaries with the stress and distress growth factors and is predicted by the same covariates
* within-person deviations: months with more or fewer experiences than that person's typical level

Two models are estimated: same-month effects of the deviations, and same-month effects plus next-month paths in both directions. Autoregressive paths among the deviations are fixed at zero, because estimating them alongside the random intercept gave an inadmissible solution.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(dplyr)
library(MplusAutomation)

# Set WD
set.seed(123)
setwd("C:XXXX")

# Import data
GZMCore <- readRDS("C:XXXX")

# Fit indices reported in the tables
fit_cols <- c("Title", "Parameters", "ChiSqM_Value", "ChiSqM_DF", "ChiSqM_PValue",
              "CFI", "RMSEA_Estimate", "RMSEA_90CI_LB", "RMSEA_90CI_UB", "SRMR", "AIC", "BIC")
```

# Mplus Data

The same data file as the primary analysis.

```{r mplus data}
GZMCore <- GZMCore %>%
  mutate(
    # Proximal minority stress composite (x) and distress (y), W0 to W4
    x1 = StressComp_W0, x2 = StressComp_W1, x3 = StressComp_W2, x4 = StressComp_W3, x5 = StressComp_W4,
    y1 = DASS_Total_W0, y2 = DASS_Total_W1, y3 = DASS_Total_W2, y4 = DASS_Total_W3, y5 = DASS_Total_W4,

    # Gender: 0 = cisgender, 1 = trans or gender diverse
    gender = case_when(GenderGroup %in% c(1, 2) ~ 0, GenderGroup %in% c(3, 4, 5, 6) ~ 1),

    # Ethnoracial identity: 0 = White, 1 = People of Colour
    race = case_when(RaceAnalysis == 1 ~ 0, RaceAnalysis == 2 ~ 1),

    # Age and baseline (lifetime) identity experience count, centred on the sample mean
    Age0    = Age - mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    msbase0 = msbase - mean(msbase, na.rm = TRUE),

    # Baseline distress group: 0 = at or below the median, 1 = above the median
    dgrp = case_when(y1 <= median(y1, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 0, y1 > median(y1, na.rm = TRUE) ~ 1)
  )

mplus_b <- GZMCore %>%
  select(m_W1, m_W2, m_W3, m_W4, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, y1, y2, y3, y4, y5,
         msbase0, Age0, gender, race, dgrp)
mplus_b[is.na(mplus_b)] <- -99
prepareMplusData(mplus_b, "modelb.dat")
```

# Models

`im` = random intercept for identity experiences; `rm2` to `rm5` = within-person deviations at W1 to W4. Each model includes a joint Wald test (MODEL TEST). Because Mplus adds some covariances by default, the two models are not strictly nested, so the Wald tests are used instead of chi-square difference tests.

```{r decomposition models}
# Same-month effects of within-person deviations
mplusSyntaxTRI1 <- ("
TITLE: TRI1 SIDE decomposition - contemporaneous effects;

DATA:
  FILE = modelb.dat;

VARIABLE:
  NAMES = m2-m5 x1-x5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp;
  USEVARIABLES = m2-m5 x1-x5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);

ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;

MODEL:
  ! Stress trajectory - freed time scores (fixed from G4S)
  ix sx | x1@0 x2@0.126 x3@-0.194 x4@-0.695 x5@1;
  [ix sx];
  ix sx;
  ix WITH sx;

  ! Distress trajectory - slope variance fixed to zero
  iy sy | y1@0 y2@1 y3@2 y4@3 y5@4;
  [iy sy];
  iy;
  sy@0;

  ! SIDE between-person component (random intercept)
  im BY m2@1 m3@1 m4@1 m5@1;
  [m2-m5@0];
  [im];
  im;

  ! Between-person covariances
  ix WITH iy;
  sx WITH iy;
  im WITH ix;
  im WITH sx;
  im WITH iy;

  [x1-x5@0];
  [y1-y5@0];

  ! Stress structured residuals
  rx1 BY x1@1; rx2 BY x2@1; rx3 BY x3@1; rx4 BY x4@1; rx5 BY x5@1;
  [rx1-rx5@0];
  x1-x5@0;

  ! Distress structured residuals
  ry1 BY y1@1; ry2 BY y2@1; ry3 BY y3@1; ry4 BY y4@1; ry5 BY y5@1;
  [ry1-ry5@0];
  y1-y5@0;

  ! SIDE structured residuals (within-person deviations)
  rm2 BY m2@1; rm3 BY m3@1; rm4 BY m4@1; rm5 BY m5@1;
  [rm2-rm5@0];
  m2-m5@0;

  rx1;
  rx2-rx5 (vsx);
  ry1;
  ry2-ry5 (vdy);
  rm2;
  rm3-rm5 (vsm);

  ! Stress AR - equality constrained
  rx2 ON rx1 (arx);
  rx3 ON rx2 (arx);
  rx4 ON rx3 (arx);
  rx5 ON rx4 (arx);

  ! Distress AR - freely estimated
  ry2 ON ry1;
  ry3 ON ry2;
  ry4 ON ry3;
  ry5 ON ry4;

  ! SIDE AR - fixed to zero
  ! Freely estimated AR alongside the SIDE random intercept produced a
  ! non-positive definite PSI matrix; SIDE stability is carried by im
  rm3 ON rm2@0;
  rm4 ON rm3@0;
  rm5 ON rm4@0;

  ! Within-time stress-distress covariances
  rx1 WITH ry1;
  rx2 WITH ry2;
  rx3 WITH ry3;
  rx4 WITH ry4;
  rx5 WITH ry5;

  ! Contemporaneous within-person SIDE effects (H1, H2)
  rx2 ON rm2 (sides_x_con);
  rx3 ON rm3 (sides_x_con);
  rx4 ON rm4 (sides_x_con);
  rx5 ON rm5 (sides_x_con);

  ry2 ON rm2 (sides_y_con);
  ry3 ON rm3 (sides_y_con);
  ry4 ON rm4 (sides_y_con);
  ry5 ON rm5 (sides_y_con);

  ! Time-invariant covariates
  ix ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;
  sx ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;
  iy ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;
  im ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;

MODEL TEST:
  ! Joint test: contemporaneous SIDE effects on stress and distress = 0
  0 = sides_x_con;
  0 = sides_y_con;

OUTPUT:
  TECH1 TECH4 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxTRI1, "modeltri1.inp")

# Same-month effects plus next-month paths in both directions
mplusSyntaxTRI2 <- ("
TITLE: TRI2 SIDE decomposition - contemporaneous and lagged;

DATA:
  FILE = modelb.dat;

VARIABLE:
  NAMES = m2-m5 x1-x5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp;
  USEVARIABLES = m2-m5 x1-x5 y1-y5 msbase0 Age0 gender race dgrp;
  MISSING = ALL(-99);

ANALYSIS:
  ESTIMATOR = MLR;
  PROCESSORS = 6;

MODEL:
  ! Stress trajectory - freed time scores (fixed from G4S)
  ix sx | x1@0 x2@0.126 x3@-0.194 x4@-0.695 x5@1;
  [ix sx];
  ix sx;
  ix WITH sx;

  ! Distress trajectory - slope variance fixed to zero
  iy sy | y1@0 y2@1 y3@2 y4@3 y5@4;
  [iy sy];
  iy;
  sy@0;

  ! SIDE between-person component (random intercept)
  im BY m2@1 m3@1 m4@1 m5@1;
  [m2-m5@0];
  [im];
  im;

  ! Between-person covariances
  ix WITH iy;
  sx WITH iy;
  im WITH ix;
  im WITH sx;
  im WITH iy;

  [x1-x5@0];
  [y1-y5@0];

  ! Stress structured residuals
  rx1 BY x1@1; rx2 BY x2@1; rx3 BY x3@1; rx4 BY x4@1; rx5 BY x5@1;
  [rx1-rx5@0];
  x1-x5@0;

  ! Distress structured residuals
  ry1 BY y1@1; ry2 BY y2@1; ry3 BY y3@1; ry4 BY y4@1; ry5 BY y5@1;
  [ry1-ry5@0];
  y1-y5@0;

  ! SIDE structured residuals (within-person deviations)
  rm2 BY m2@1; rm3 BY m3@1; rm4 BY m4@1; rm5 BY m5@1;
  [rm2-rm5@0];
  m2-m5@0;

  rx1;
  rx2-rx5 (vsx);
  ry1;
  ry2-ry5 (vdy);
  rm2;
  rm3-rm5 (vsm);

  ! Stress AR - equality constrained
  rx2 ON rx1 (arx);
  rx3 ON rx2 (arx);
  rx4 ON rx3 (arx);
  rx5 ON rx4 (arx);

  ! Distress AR - freely estimated
  ry2 ON ry1;
  ry3 ON ry2;
  ry4 ON ry3;
  ry5 ON ry4;

  ! SIDE AR - fixed to zero
  ! Freely estimated AR alongside the SIDE random intercept produced a
  ! non-positive definite PSI matrix; SIDE stability is carried by im
  rm3 ON rm2@0;
  rm4 ON rm3@0;
  rm5 ON rm4@0;

  ! Within-time stress-distress covariances
  rx1 WITH ry1;
  rx2 WITH ry2;
  rx3 WITH ry3;
  rx4 WITH ry4;
  rx5 WITH ry5;

  ! Contemporaneous within-person SIDE effects (H1, H2)
  rx2 ON rm2 (sides_x_con);
  rx3 ON rm3 (sides_x_con);
  rx4 ON rm4 (sides_x_con);
  rx5 ON rm5 (sides_x_con);

  ry2 ON rm2 (sides_y_con);
  ry3 ON rm3 (sides_y_con);
  ry4 ON rm4 (sides_y_con);
  ry5 ON rm5 (sides_y_con);

  ! Lagged SIDE -> stress/distress (H3, H4)
  rx3 ON rm2 (m_to_x);
  rx4 ON rm3 (m_to_x);
  rx5 ON rm4 (m_to_x);

  ry3 ON rm2 (m_to_y);
  ry4 ON rm3 (m_to_y);
  ry5 ON rm4 (m_to_y);

  ! Lagged stress/distress -> SIDE (reverse direction)
  rm2 ON rx1 (x_to_m);
  rm3 ON rx2 (x_to_m);
  rm4 ON rx3 (x_to_m);
  rm5 ON rx4 (x_to_m);

  rm2 ON ry1 (y_to_m);
  rm3 ON ry2 (y_to_m);
  rm4 ON ry3 (y_to_m);
  rm5 ON ry4 (y_to_m);

  ! Time-invariant covariates
  ix ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;
  sx ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;
  iy ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;
  im ON dgrp Age0 gender race msbase0;

MODEL TEST:
  ! Joint test: all lagged paths (both directions) = 0
  0 = m_to_x;
  0 = m_to_y;
  0 = x_to_m;
  0 = y_to_m;

OUTPUT:
  TECH1 TECH4 STDYX CINTERVAL;
")
writeLines(mplusSyntaxTRI2, "modeltri2.inp")

runModels("modeltri1.inp")
runModels("modeltri2.inp")
```

# Results

```{r admissibility}
# Warning lines in each output (none = admissible)
grep("NOT POSITIVE DEFINITE|NEGATIVE|NO CONVERGENCE", readLines("modeltri1.out"), value = TRUE)
grep("NOT POSITIVE DEFINITE|NEGATIVE|NO CONVERGENCE", readLines("modeltri2.out"), value = TRUE)
```

```{r table s13a}
tri_summaries <- bind_rows(
  readModels("modeltri1.out", what = "summaries")$summaries,
  readModels("modeltri2.out", what = "summaries")$summaries
)

table_s13a <- select(tri_summaries, any_of(fit_cols))
table_s13a
write.csv(table_s13a, "TableS13a_decomposition_fit.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Wald tests: same-month effects = 0 (first model); all next-month paths = 0 (second model)
select(tri_summaries, Title, WaldChiSq_Value, WaldChiSq_DF, WaldChiSq_PValue)
```

```{r table s13b}
tri1 <- readModels("modeltri1.out", what = "parameters")$parameters
tri2 <- readModels("modeltri2.out", what = "parameters")$parameters

table_s13b_tri1 <- tri1$stdyx.standardized %>%
  left_join(select(tri1$ci.stdyx.standardized, paramHeader, param, low2.5, up2.5),
            by = c("paramHeader", "param"))
table_s13b_tri2 <- tri2$stdyx.standardized %>%
  left_join(select(tri2$ci.stdyx.standardized, paramHeader, param, low2.5, up2.5),
            by = c("paramHeader", "param"))

write.csv(table_s13b_tri1, "TableS13b_same_month_model.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(table_s13b_tri2, "TableS13b_lagged_model.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Key results: same-month effects of within-person deviations
filter(table_s13b_tri1, param %in% c("RM2", "RM3", "RM4", "RM5"))
filter(table_s13b_tri2, param %in% c("RM2", "RM3", "RM4", "RM5"))

# Key results: next-month paths from stress (RX) and distress (RY) to identity experiences
filter(table_s13b_tri2, paramHeader %in% c("RM2.ON", "RM3.ON", "RM4.ON", "RM5.ON"))

# Key results: covariances of the random intercept, and covariate effects on it
filter(table_s13b_tri1, paramHeader == "IM.WITH" | param == "IM", paramHeader != "Means")
filter(table_s13b_tri1, paramHeader == "IM.ON")
```

```{r share of stable variance}
# Share of variance in monthly counts due to stable differences between young people
# = random intercept variance / (random intercept variance + W1 deviation variance)
tri1_unstd <- tri1$unstandardized
var_intercept <- filter(tri1_unstd, param == "IM",  paramHeader %in% c("Variances", "Residual.Variances"))$est
var_deviation <- filter(tri1_unstd, param == "RM2", paramHeader %in% c("Variances", "Residual.Variances"))$est
round(var_intercept / (var_intercept + var_deviation), 3)
```

```{r compare with primary}
# Same-month effects in the primary model, for comparison
primary <- readModels("modelbiv3a_cond.out", what = "parameters")$parameters$stdyx.standardized
filter(primary, param %in% c("M2", "M3", "M4", "M5"))
```
